item.text: I found one functional difference in pair 1: B passes an entire rate batch as arguments to `push`, which can exceed the runtime’s argument limit. A’s loop avoids that failure; neither the task nor the adapter contract limits batch size. The remaining pairs are ties: their differences do not establish a contract or maintainability advantage.
